note: Approved observation protocol digests (ARCH_PLAN Step 3.1a). Re-approved 2026-09-16 when clip/scale/noise values entered the record; the diff against the previous approval was verified to be representation only (no term, order, dropped or flag change). The gate reads this file and never rewrites it: a new or edited protocol stays red until a human writes its digest here. A protocol no task references must state a purpose. dims are the approved per-group widths KEYED BY THE ASSET they were measured on ({assets/<family>/<family>.usda: {group: width}}): one protocol can be instantiated on two bodies of different joint counts and then legitimately carry two widths (lizard 26 joints / policy 90 vs lizard2 30 joints / policy 102, measured 2026-09-22), and a map keyed by protocol alone would compare one body against the other body's number forever. Empty = no real run has asserted them.. dims_digest pins the approved widths; a width may only change with a re-approval. Every protocol carrying widths must also cite what asserted them (``evidence``): the digest is recomputable, the citation is not, and a re-approval that cites nothing leaves no trace a reader can follow -- the same level of control as the golden's ``--update --reason``.
